Title: IBM APAR PI00001: sample connector hangs on shutdown - United States

Text:
APAR STATUS
CLOSED AS PROGRAM ERROR.

ERROR DESCRIPTION
The connector hangs when the queue manager is stopped.

LOCAL FIX
Restart the connector process manually.

PROBLEM SUMMARY
Users of the sample connector are affected.

PROBLEM CONCLUSION
The shutdown hook was corrected to release the lock.

TEMPORARY FIX
None.

COMMENTS
No additional comments.

APAR INFORMATION
APAR NUMBER: PI00001
REPORTED COMPONENT NAME: SAMPLE CONNECTOR
